## What Was Requested

Task 2: Init Job — create 2 files under `deploy/kubernetes/base/init/`:

**job.yaml** must have:
- apiVersion: batch/v1, kind: Job
- name: churn-renewal-forecast-migrate
- namespace: churn-renewal-forecast
- labels: app.kubernetes.io/name: churn-renewal-forecast, app.kubernetes.io/component: migrate
- spec.ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 300
- spec.backoffLimit: 3
- template.spec.serviceAccountName: churn-renewal-forecast
- template.spec.restartPolicy: OnFailure
- container name: migrate
- image: registry.ic-ops.net/churn-renewal-forecast:latest
- command: ["bunx", "prisma", "migrate", "deploy"]

- apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1, kind: Kustomization
